The '''Hocekureem Sea''' was a [[Salt water|saltwater]] [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]]. Sometimes referred to as just '''Hocekureem''', it was most well known as the natural habitat of the [[Fleek eel/Legends|fleek eel]], renowned as a delicacy across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The ocean's [[Salt/Legends|salt]] was also sometimes used as a seasoning in [[Xizor salad|salads]].

==Description==
Located on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="tea">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]],<ref name="cswe" /> the Hocekureem Sea was a [[Salt water|saltwater]] [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] suitable for animal life. Often referred to as just Hocekureem, the ocean was the natural habitat of the [[Fleek eel/Legends|fleek eel]], an edible sea creature<ref name="prime">{{KOTORbackups|0}}</ref> that was considered a delicacy by chefs [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxywide]].<ref name="fleek">{{CSWECite|I|280|Fleek eel}}</ref>

==History==
In [[3964 BBY]], a [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] self-proclaimed industrialist going by the name "[[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Marn Hierogryph|Hieromarn]]" tried to solicit investors on the planet [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] for a venture to bring fleek [[Eel/Legends|eels]] from the Hocekureem Sea to Taris for the local restaurant trade. Promising a three-for-one return on investment, Hieromarn guaranteed that fleek eel would be an [[Upper City]] delicacy within eight [[Standard month/Legends|months]].<ref name="prime" /> Thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], an eatery in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] district, offered a dish called the [[Xizor salad]], which was fresh [[Sizhranian lettuce/Legends|Sizhranian lettuce]] tossed with [[Hocekureem Sea salt crouton]]s. On the menu, it was advertised as being "fit for a [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Prince/Legends|prince]]!"<ref name="dex">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Hocekureem Sea was first mentioned in the novel [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'']], written by [[Steve Perry]] and released in [[1996]].<ref name="sote">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref> Although never actually making a direct appearance, the Hocekureem Sea was also mentioned in ''[[The Taris Holofeed: Prime Edition]]'', an [[in-universe]] news report appearing on the last page of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] [[Knights of the Old Republic 0|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 0]],<ref name="prime" /> and the [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] article "[[Dining at Dex's]]."<ref name="dex" /> In [[2008]], the Hocekureem Sea was given an entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="cswe" />
